systemMap.title: How mail {accent}
systemMap.intro: From queue to inbox — and back. Delivery signals feed the ramp controller, so your sending reputation grows instead of guessing.
systemMap.srDescription: Diagram of Owlat's mail flow: campaigns, automations and API sends queue on the built-in Owlat MTA; messages pass an authentication gate applying DKIM, SPF and DMARC, then reach recipient inboxes. Bounce, engagement and placement signals flow back into a ramp controller, which adjusts the MTA's sending share and pacing — a continuous deliverability feedback loop.

features.title: Everything you need{break} to ship {accent}
features.intro: From builder to inbox, every tool in one platform.

editor.title: Block-based email editor
editor.desc: 17 drag-and-drop block types with inline text editing. Build with text, images, buttons, columns, tables, carousels, and more. Save blocks to your library, manage translations per language, and preview across devices in real time.

audience.title: Audience engine
audience.desc: Store contacts with custom properties, organize into topics with double opt-in, build dynamic segments with filters, import via CSV, and capture leads with embeddable forms.

campaigns.title: Campaigns + A/B testing
campaigns.desc: Schedule sends for optimal timing, test subject lines and content variants side by side, then track opens, clicks, and engagement as results come in.

automations.title: Automations
automations.desc: Build trigger-based flows for onboarding, re-engagement, and lifecycle messaging. Add delays, conditions, and branching logic — no code required.

transactional.title: Transactional delivery
transactional.desc: Send password resets, order confirmations, and receipts via API. Reference templates by slug or ID, inject dynamic data variables, and fall back to the default language automatically.

deliverability.title: Deliverability
deliverability.desc: Verify your sending domain with guided DNS setup for SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. Manage blocklists, automatically include one-click unsubscribe headers, and stream delivery events via webhooks for full visibility.

developers.title: Ship with the SDK,{break} or stay in the {accent}
developers.intro: Send transactional emails, manage contacts, trigger automations, and track delivery with a single API call. Use the TypeScript SDK for type-safe integrations or hit the REST API directly from any language.

openSource.title: Built in the open,{break} owned by {accent}
openSource.intro: Inspect every line, self-host on your terms, and contribute to the platform you rely on. Fork it, extend it, migrate away — you always own your email stack.

github.title: View on GitHub
github.desc: Every line of code is auditable. Report issues, submit PRs, and shape the roadmap.

selfHosting.title: Self-hosting guide
selfHosting.desc: Deploy on your own infrastructure. Your data stays where you decide — no vendor lock-in.

pricing.title: Free {accent}. Your infrastructure.
